name: lcd_round_panel
title: Round display
purpose: Zhongjingyuan ZJY128R-IG01 1.28" round TFT (GC9A01, 240x240, SPI) on the back of the board, its flex soldered to the board and folded under it, with Waveshare's backlight switch

sources.title: Zhongjingyuan ZJY128R-IG01 1.28 inch round TFT LCD datasheet (Rev A)
sources.read: p3 general, p4 mechanical drawing and pin table, p6 electrical

parts.quote: pins "1 GND, 2 LEDK, 3 LEDA, 4 VDD, 5 GND, 6 GND, 7 D/C, 8 CS, 9 SCL, 10 SDA, 11 RESET, 12 GND"; FPC 0.7 pitch, 12 contacts; "Active area Ø32.4"; footprint drawn from the drawing
C1 104 from 3V3 to GND at the panel
Q1 8050 (J3Y); SOT-23 "1. BASE 2. EMITTER 3. COLLECTOR", "MARKING: J3Y", IC 0.5 A
R1 10 from LEDK to Q1's collector
R2 1K from BL to Q1's base

layout.rules: Panel and its pads on the back; the flex is folded under the panel as the drawing's bent view. BL high (or open, R8 to 3V3) turns the backlight on. Pads as the flex's contacts (0.35 x 2.00 at 0.7, zjy128 p4); alignment holes 10.00 apart, 2.00 beyond the contacts. Folded under, the contacts face the board with pin 1 on the right seen from the screen, as the drawing's front view.

open_questions: Backlight without the maker's recommended constant-current driver ("It is recommended to use IC (AW9364)", zjy128 p7), as on Waveshare's module: at most (3.35 - 2.9) V / 10 Ω = 45 mA (AP2112's +1.5%, the LED's lowest VLED, the transistor's drop taken as 0), under the 60 mA maximum; with VLED 3.1 V it can be as low as about 25 mA, so brightness varies between panels.

VDD runs from the 3.3 V rail: the panel's maximum is 3.3 V (2.8 typ, 4.6 absolute), the AP2112 is ±1.5% (up to 3.35 V); Waveshare's module does the same. A 2.8 V regulator for the panel would remove it.

Antenna: the module's antenna overhangs the board edge as Espressif recommends; the panel's backlight frame is on the back about 5 mm from the antenna's edge, not under it. Espressif asks for at least 15 mm clearance from the housing and a range test of the finished product.
